in_marathi.name: Nirupam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Immeasurable, Beyond Comparison
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirupam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nirupam means immeasurable or beyond comparison. In Hindu mythology, it is a name of Lord Vishnu and Shiva, signifying their supreme and unparalleled power.
